fields.name: eyebrow
fields.label: Eyebrow — small text above headline
fields.description: Appears above the large headline. Example: UK Bangla Tigers Cricket Club

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Headline
fields.description: Large hero headline. Use \n for a line break. Keep concise and impactful.

fields.name: tagline
fields.label: Supporting text
fields.description: Short supporting line under the headline. Shown under the hero. Keep to one sentence.

fields.name: metaDescription
fields.label: Homepage meta description (SEO)
fields.description: Search-result snippet for the homepage. Factual club summary, 120-160 characters.

fields.name: heroImage
fields.label: Hero background image
fields.description: Team photo shown behind hero text. Use a wide, high-quality image (min 1080px wide).

fields.name: primaryCtaLabel
fields.label: Primary button — label
fields.description: Text on the main hero button. Example: Join the Club

fields.name: primaryCtaLink
fields.label: Primary button — link
fields.description: Where the button goes. Must be a site page like /join or /contact

fields.name: secondaryCtaLabel
fields.label: Secondary button — label
fields.description: Second hero button. Optional — leave blank to hide.

fields.name: secondaryCtaLink
fields.label: Secondary button — link
fields.description: Where the second button goes. Required if label is set.

fields.name: clubIntroLede
fields.label: About teaser — intro line
fields.description: Short paragraph on homepage that introduces the club. Under hero, before stats.

fields.name: whyChooseUs
fields.label: Why Choose Us — reasons
fields.description: Four cards under Club Intro. Keep titles short, bodies 1–2 sentences.

fields.name: heroSubline
fields.label: Hero subline
fields.description: Large subtitle under Page banner on About. Example: Building a legacy of cricket excellence…

fields.name: storyBody
fields.label: Club story — paragraphs
fields.description: Main story paragraphs. Keep 2–3 short paragraphs; avoid inventing facts.

fields.name: aboutImage
fields.label: About page — feature image
fields.description: Image shown alongside the story. Use 1000×1200 or similar portrait.

fields.name: aboutImageAlt
fields.label: Feature image — alternative text
fields.description: Describe the image for screen readers. Required if image is set.

fields.name: leadershipIntro
fields.label: Leadership — intro paragraph
fields.description: Short intro before leadership cards. Mention founder + acting chairman + vice-chairman only.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Questions & answers
fields.description: Add, reorder, or hide questions. Keep answers factual and concise.

fields.name: visible
fields.label: Show this question
fields.description: Turn off to hide without deleting.

fields.name: siteTaglineShort
fields.label: Short tagline
fields.description: Used in meta, footer, SEO. Example: United by Passion. Driven by Cricket.

fields.name: phoneHref
fields.label: Phone — link
fields.description: tel: link, e.g. tel:+447827627997

fields.name: socialCard
fields.label: Social share image
fields.description: Shown when sharing on social. 1200×630 recommended.
